waveform.name: Time-Domain Waveform
waveform.description: Represents instantaneous acoustic air pressure fluctuations over time. Shows amplitude dynamics, speech phrasing, silence pauses, and overall energy envelope.
waveform.dsp_significance: Essential for inspecting clipping distortion, speech cadence, and envelope contours.

mel_spectrogram.name: Mel-Scale Spectrogram
mel_spectrogram.description: Decomposes the audio signal into time-frequency energy representations mapped to the psychoacoustic Mel scale, reflecting human non-linear pitch perception.
mel_spectrogram.dsp_significance: The primary input representation used by modern neural vocoders and deepfake detection CNNs.

mfcc.name: Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC)
mfcc.description: Compact representation of the short-term spectral envelope, computed by taking the Discrete Cosine Transform (DCT) of log mel energies.
mfcc.dsp_significance: Captures vocal tract resonance shapes (formants) while discarding glottal excitation, making it the golden standard for speaker identification.

pitch_f0.name: Fundamental Frequency (Pitch F0)
pitch_f0.description: The rate of vocal cord vibration during voiced speech segments, estimated using the probabilistic YIN (pYIN) algorithm.
pitch_f0.dsp_significance: Reveals speaker intonation, prosody, and emotional inflection. Synthetic speech often lacks micro-jitter naturalness.

spectral_centroid.name: Spectral Centroid & Rolloff
spectral_centroid.description: The spectral centroid corresponds to the brightness or sharpness of the sound. Spectral rolloff marks the frequency cutoff containing 85% of total signal energy.
spectral_centroid.dsp_significance: Human vocal tracts have natural high-frequency roll-offs, whereas synthetic vocoders frequently exhibit telltale high-frequency suppression or artifacts.

zero_crossing_rate.name: Zero Crossing Rate & HPSS
zero_crossing_rate.description: Tracks how frequently the signal changes sign, differentiating unvoiced fricatives from voiced vowels, alongside Harmonic-Percussive source decomposition.
zero_crossing_rate.dsp_significance: Crucial for analyzing vocal stability and background noise consistency.
